scope: Local Windows device inventory, bounded driver-package inspection, compatibility evidence and reversible gaming profiles.

reference.warning: The supplied 66-point list mixes cumulative updates, inherited behavior, absence statements, repeated topics and Windows-specific constraints. It is not treated as an authoritative XP SP3 changelog or as a requirement to reproduce legacy Windows behavior.

adoption_rules.rule: Only claim implemented when repository code and tests or operational evidence support the exact behavior. Partial requires evidence and explicit limits. Not applicable requires a product-scope reason. Historical Windows features are not silently represented as native capabilities.

source_groups.title: User interface, shell, multimedia and storage

controls.assessment: Read-only PnP and package inspection, bounded archive checks and signature metadata are available; no driver installation, loading or safety verdict is provided.
limitations: Evidence such as a signature or matching hardware ID must not be presented as an installation recommendation.

controls.assessment: OPlague is a local Windows workbench and does not expose a network service or network-adapter policy manager.
limitations: Network policy and NAP/IPsec controls are outside the current product boundary.

controls.assessment: Driver deployment and system servicing are deliberately outside scope; package inspection must remain non-destructive.
limitations: Do not turn inspection into driver installation or registry/device mutation.

controls.assessment: The Windows desktop workbench, local reports and snapshots exist; it is not a system shell or general file-management service.
limitations: Keep snapshots and reports local and disclose machine-specific data.

controls.assessment: Architecture mapping, normalized hardware-ID candidates and versioned evidence are available; candidate edges do not prove driver suitability or OS support.
limitations: Compatibility results remain advisory and require manual review.
